summary.en: Reply to a message with @reply (paste a screenshot, read on your Mac), save snippets, send notes to Notion or a folder, translate as you type, sync settings and (if you choose) API keys through iCloud, and use the interface in nine languages. @config and @doctor moved to Settings → Assistant.
summary.zh: 用 @reply 回复消息（可以粘贴截图，在本机识别）、保存片段、把笔记存到 Notion 或文件夹、边打边译、通过 iCloud 同步设置和（可选的）API 密钥，界面支持九种语言。@config 和 @doctor 搬到了设置 →「助手」。
